evidence.reason: In `_capture_document`, `equivalence` is computed at line 93 and only then is `capture.update(overrides)` applied at line 94. An override of `target` changes an input to `current_equivalence`, so the stored digest becomes stale; `write_receipt` hashes the document as given and does not recompute it. This is an implementation ordering defect in the fixture capture helper, and the suggested fix recomputes after applying the override.
